title: Reliable Update Delivery for Every Device
notes: Improved: updates are now applied only when your device has actually received the new version — no more false 'updated' states
Improved: version checks are ordered numerically, so a past version can never overwrite a newer one on any device
Improved: every page (including Login, Register, and Investor pages) now checks for updates, and open tabs re-check every few minutes while you browse
Improved: stronger cache-busting guarantees every device picks up the newest app files without manual clearing
